approval: This program computes measurements only; source-protocol approval, if any, is a separate artifact.

exclusions: Running heads and folios: line yMin < 50 on ordinary pages
Chapter display: line yMin < 170 on chapter opening pages, except page 136 threshold 210
Map internals, numbered map key and source credit on pages 3, 127, 129, 225, 345
Map number label at caption start
Standalone numeric words of bbox height < 8 points: superscript note callouts
protocol.token: Whitespace-delimited unit containing at least one Unicode letter or number; retained lexical compounds count once
protocol.line_wraps: Remove terminal hyphen followed across a line break by a letter; join across contiguous ordinary pages of the same chapter, assigning the joined word to its first page
protocol.scope: Owned source pages only, once each; no context-page duplication or inferred absent material
protocol.source_role_note: Maps remain eligible semantic evidence even though graphic internals are excluded from the prose density denominator
protocol.limits: An exact extraction-based operational denominator, not a claim of linguistically unique word segmentation; spacing inherited from the PDF may separate possessives or words around em dashes.
